mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventories (product_id, current_stock, min_stock, max_stock, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{productId}, #{currentStock}, #{minStock}, #{maxStock}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventories i LEFT JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.id
AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productName}, '%')
AND p.category = #{category}
AND i.current_stock <= i.min_stock
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventories WHERE current_stock <= min_stock AND current_stock > 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventories WHERE current_stock = 0
SELECT id, product_id, current_stock, min_stock, max_stock, created_at, updated_at FROM inventories ORDER BY updated_at DESC
